core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hareem corresponds to the Arabic form حريم (Arabic root ح ر م (ḥ-r-m); حَرِيم (Ḥarīm)). Its core sense is intimate, innermost, sacred precinct. Hareem is Arabic حَرِيم (Ḥarīm) 'the women's quarters, a sacred/inviolable precinct; the innermost part of a house', from the root ح ر م (ḥ-r-m). The source gloss 'intimate, innermost' reflects the sense of the root; the lexical sense of حريم is the inviolable inner space. Same name as harim.
